about: Ark scene asset library (scripts/ark-assets). Procedural, made in this repo (CC0, see docs/ark-credits.md). Files are under `base`; every GLB is one mesh, one primitive, one vertex-coloured material, meshopt-compressed (EXT_meshopt_compression, float positions: no node transform), read with GLTFLoader + MeshoptDecoder.
units: metres, +Y up, origin at the ground contact (trees: trunk base at y=0)

attributes.COLOR_0: linear RGBA vertex colour (the whole look: no textures). three: geometry 'color'
attributes._WIND: vec4 unorm8, three: geometry '_wind'. x sway weight (0 at the ground; trunk <=0.2, branches 0.2-0.9, leaves 0.9-1), y phase of the limb (0..1, a leaf shares its limb's), z flutter (0 at a leaf's stalk -> 1 at its tip, 0 on wood), w the leaf's own phase (0..1)
attributes.morph: flowers carry one morph target named 'closed' (weight 0 open, 1 closed)

material: Each lod lists doubleSided. true (leaves, petals, blades are single sheets): side DoubleSide; false (cards, which carry both faces as geometry; closed solids): side FrontSide
lods: lod0 near (attach points are real geometry here), lod1 mid, lod2 far, card = crossed vertex-coloured silhouettes for the horizon. lod_distances (m) are suggestions: lod0 below [0], lod1 below [1], lod2 below [2], card beyond
attach: Per set `<set>/attach.json`: {assetId: [{tag, p, n, f, q, size, spot, lod, ...}]} in asset space. n = the animal's up (surface normal), f = its forward along the surface, q = the quaternion (x,y,z,w) taking local +Y to n and +Z to f, size = [min, max] body length (m) that fits. spot = the nearest micro.ts MicroSpot.

leaf.about: upper side of a real leaf blade

branch.about: top of a roughly horizontal branch; forward runs along it

bark.about: trunk surface; normal points out, forward points up the trunk (clingers)

tree_hollow.about: the mouth of a hole in a trunk; normal out of the hole

crown.about: the top of a palm trunk among the frond bases

frond.about: top of a palm frond's midrib

root.about: top of an above-ground root (prop roots, root flares)

fruit.about: on top of a hanging fruit

flower_head.about: the centre of an open flower, normal out of the flower

bromeliad.about: the water cup of a bromeliad rosette

fungus_shelf.about: the top of a bracket fungus

stem.about: a plant stem or grass blade; forward runs up it

pad.about: the top of a floating leaf (lily pad)

rock_face.about: a rock surface, up-facing or steep

ledge.about: a flat shelf on a cliff or boulder

crevice.about: a crack or gap between stones; normal out of it

tide_pool.about: the water surface in a rock hollow

burrow_entrance.about: an opening into the ground, a log or under a stone

cave_mouth.about: the floor at the mouth of a cave

cave_ceiling.about: the underside of a cave roof (bats); normal points down

leaf_litter.about: the ground among fallen leaves, twigs or cones

log_top.about: the top of a fallen log; forward runs along it

shell.about: on or in a shell on the shore
